decisive_items: excessive sweating of the buttocks, most severe at the intergluteal cleft and sacrum
response.rationale: R4 captures the underlying primary/idiopathic nature of this focal hyperhidrosis presentation, supported by the axillary history and the distribution; R5 and R2 are less specific regarding the primary versus secondary distinction.

rejected.why: Hyperhidrosis is too broad and fails to differentiate primary from secondary causes, whereas the clinical picture strongly indicates primary hyperhidrosis.
